YOUR EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK, ABRIDGED

Welcome to the team.
Mind the flying stationery.

01

Find your feet

Click the floor to walk, or use WASD / arrow keys. Click a desk or a case to head toward it.

02

Do some good

Visit a department counter and press E to work a case. Each employee also has an assigned desk with space to stand and chat.

03

Manage the mayhem

Handle loud calls, leaking headphones, kitchen disasters, and the gym visitor. Managers check the coffee, help organize staff, and tidy desks. Check your desk for their notes.

04

Keep your cool

Coffee and an available gym lower stress. Your department earns a bonus. Finish an 8-minute shift for results.

Space or Esc pauses solo play. Online offices keep running while you take a break. Visit Congierge to answer waiting calls. Use Mixer to adjust the room, phones, and spoken voices. Use Floor studio to design an office before opening a room. Office chatter includes the Overheard feed, team messages, and NPC conversations.

A LITTLE CONTEXT

Serious benefits.
Very unserious office.

Harmony Benefits is a fictional workplace inspired by the benefits consulting, retirement, Flex, COBRA, and concierge services in Vita Companies' public materials.

All characters and incidents are invented. Cases and timers are simplified entertainment. This independently created game is not an official Vita product.

Build a custom floor, play solo, or share an online office with up to four players. Team chat and the Overheard feed keep everyone in the loop. Remote workers are a future addition.
